scope: Source-level inventory of the constants, cutoffs, and Hypothesis 1 inputs needed to turn Maynard Proposition 6.1 and Sections 8-9 into finite numerical inequalities. This is not a quantitative reproof or a numerical threshold certificate.

source_registry.title: Small Gaps Between Products of Two Primes
source_registry.authors: D. A. Goldston, S. W. Graham, J. Pintz, C. Y. Yildirim
source_registry.role: Maynard Lemma 8.3 specializes GGPY Lemma 4 to kappa=1. H1b-1b retains the corrected absolute transfer C4_abs=2*C3_abs as a secondary route. H1b-1b-2b follows Ford's corrected Wirsing theorem, H1b-1b-2c supplies actual a=1/2, A2=8 and L=5+log(Lambda_star), H1b-1b-2d closes the direct-smooth r-fold subpackage, H1b-1b-2d.1a bypasses the line-905 functional C1 requirement, H1b-1b-2d.1a.1 closes its scalar remainder, and H1b-1b-2d.1b closes both sharp-scale calls under the actual FGKMT/FMT specialization.

status_vocabulary.PRINTED_EXPLICIT: The reviewed source prints a usable finite formula or numerical exponent for this row, although upstream rows may remain open.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL_EXPLICIT: Some parameters or decay exponents are printed, but at least one multiplier or finite cutoff is missing.
status_vocabulary.PROJECT_FINITE_COMPONENT_CLOSED: A separate project theorem closes only the named component, not the composed Maynard package.
status_vocabulary.PARAMETERIZED_EXPLICIT_INPUTS_OPEN: A project theorem supplies an explicit formula and finite range, but actual invocation parameters still require one common numerical certificate.
status_vocabulary.ACTUAL_INPUTS_PARAMETERIZED_EXPLICIT: The actual application inputs and one-step multiplier are explicit in the named global parameters, while higher composition remains open.
status_vocabulary.RATE_MISSING: The row contains O, o, Vinogradov notation, or sufficiently-large language without a usable numerical multiplier and range.
status_vocabulary.SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The row imports a cited lower-level result whose quantitative proof was not audited here.
status_vocabulary.INPUT_PACKAGE_MISSING: The row requires numerical Hypothesis 1 inputs that the source assumes rather than supplies.
status_vocabulary.HARD_BLOCKER: The package cannot be composed into a numerical certificate until upstream constants and a common cutoff are supplied.
